title: predict.proofreader_verdict.v1
description: Phase 6 — proofreader verdict on a `predict.final` consensus output. Emitted by the proofreader reactor that subscribes to `predict.final` and applies sanity / cross-source / market-implied checks before downstream consumers (NLP composer, API) accept the prediction. `verdict` is the categorical decision; `score` is a [0,1] proofreading confidence (1 = strong agreement with consensus, 0 = strong disagreement). `flags` enumerate every check that fired so an operator can correlate with proof.flag stream. Mirrors the dataclass that will land in `ai/swarm/agents/payloads.py::ProofreaderVerdict` (Phase 6).

request_id.description: Request id this verdict pertains to (round-trips from predict.request → predict.final → here).

prediction_id.description: Deterministic id of the predict.final being verified.

verdict.description: accept = consensus passes all checks; warn = consensus shipped with caveats (operator-visible); reject = consensus must not be served to clients.

flags.description: Names of every check that fired (e.g. 'odds_implied_disagree', 'home_xg_zero', 'late_vote_majority').

checks_run.description: Names of every check that was executed; `flags` ⊆ `checks_run`.

calibration_version.description: Echo of the predict.final calibration_version, so verdicts can be replayed against an immutable audit trail.
